title: Non-monotonic pause/resume times pass validation and wrap u64 arithmetic in ticks_stepped_by, silently mis-lowering blessed apply_ticks
detail: u64 subtraction wraps when a resume precedes its pause (re < pe): n inflates and commands silently log at wrong apply_ticks (verified 161 vs 121) or never apply — a corrupted log blessed without failing loud.
recommended_fix: At parse time require each pause/resume at_ms >= the previous event's at_ms (monotonic schedule), mirroring the existing arity/alternation checks; alternatively saturate the window subtraction in ticks_stepped_by.

title: Unchecked i64 multiply in new pause effect-tick arithmetic silently wraps for huge at_ms
detail: at_ms near i64 max makes at_ms*logic_hz overflow-wrap before the max(0,...) clamp, landing the pause at an arbitrary early tick (verified: effect tick 1) instead of failing loud like other demo typos.
recommended_fix: Reject at parse time any at_ms where at_ms > (i64 max)/logic_hz would overflow the product (a parse_ms-range check), matching the fail-loud unknown-tier/bad-arity convention.
